sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Bracelet Combo Set – Delicate Heart Link Chain & Minimalist Pearl Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Double the elegance with this chic gold-toned bracelet set. Featuring a romantic heart-link chain and a delicate pearl strand, this high-fashion combo is perfect for effortless layering. To preserve its radiant golden luster, keep these pieces dry and store them safely away from perfumes and moisture.
